name: Inami (Hyōgo, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Inami town emblem in white: a ring of two interlocking curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Inami, a town in Hyōgo Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1956.

features.role: Inami town emblem — a ring of two interlocking curved strokes
